title: Pride and Duty (Will Take You from the Mountain)

entries.english: After agreeing to report back to him anything you learn, gentlemanly bastard Neale has given you information regarding the whereabouts of a mysterious new member of the Company of Heroes. The man's name is Curious Gorge and rumor has it that he is holed up in a cave southeast of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan. It is said that he has journeyed from the Farreach and may be skilled in the ancient techniques of the legendary mountain warriors.

After warning you not to mock his unique name─on pain of decapitation─Curious Gorge tells you of his village, their art, and his reasons for journeying south. He also invites you to train in the ancient ways of the warrior, but only after proving that your will is strong enough to endure the challenge by slaying the antling workers which make their nest to the north of Curious Gorge's cave.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
You have slain the antling workers. Now return to Curious Gorge's cave and inform the Hellsguard of your victory.
※ The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 35.

Gentlemanly bastard Neale has offered information regarding the whereabouts of a mysterious new member of the Company of Heroes if you agree to report back to the Astalicia after talking with the Hellsguard warrior.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Deciphering the ancient chronicles is proving to be difficult for Curious Gorge, but he was able to learn of a legendary set of armor lost when its proud owner cast it from a mountain on Ablathia's Spine. Unfortunately, the remainder of the tale will require more time to translate. In the meantime, your teacher has devised a second exercise which will help temper your will, allowing you to tap the power of your inner beast and slay even the most nimble of foes. Travel to Humblehearth in the Black Shroud and seek out the beastkin known as Sirocco.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 40.

title: Curious Gorge Goes to the Bazaar

entries.english: Curious Gorge has learned from the chronicles that his tribe supposedly fell from grace when the city-states blamed the art of the warrior for the terrible transformation that befell a handful of newly trained soldiers and led them to murder. Not able to accept this fate, Curious Gorge has pledged to prove his tribe's innocence by showing the realm the power and skill of a true warrior─starting with a Company of Heroes mission to slay a flock of carnivorous condors that nests to the north of the Silver Bazaar.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
You have slain the condors in the north. Travel to the east gate of the Silver Bazaar to complete the two-pronged attack devised by Curious Gorge.

As you arrive in the Silver Bazaar, you bear witness to utter pandemonium as Curious Gorge's frenzied slaughter of the canyon condors comes to a close. Horrified by what they have just seen, the hamlet's residents lambaste their savior, calling him a monster. Unable to fully comprehend what has happened, Curious Gorge flees from the scene. Perhaps you should pay him a visit.
The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 45.

(Recommended)

At long last, Curious Gorge has discovered the location of his ancestor's legendary armor. Apparently, each of the five pieces that make up the set has been buried at the site of a great battle. He has marked your map with four of the locations, choosing to retrieve the final piece himself. The locations are as follows:[@CR]- Cutter's Cry in northern Thanalan.[@CR]- Natalan in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- Turning Leaf in the West Shroud.[@CR]- Craneperch Tower in lower La Noscea.
The next warrior quest from Curious Gorge is now available.

When unable to channel the power of the legendary cuirass, Curious Gorge comes to the conclusion that his ancestors are waiting for him to prove his strength before allowing him access to their secrets. To do this, he proposes a challenge based on a passage from the chronicles that tells of a final technique only passed down to those warriors who have slain the most monstrous of beasts. In short, whoever fells Audhumbla from the caves of Iron Lake and earns the technique first will lay claim to all five pieces of the legendary armor.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that seven party members accompany you.
The next warrior quest will be available from Curious Gorge upon reaching level 50.

Before settling the issue regarding who is to receive the complete set of ancient armor, Curious Gorge has asked you to accompany him once again to the Silver Bazaar where it is said a terrible creature is attacking the hamlet's citizens. He believes this is an opportune moment to prove to the realm that the art of the warrior is not one to be feared.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Upon arriving in the Silver Bazaar, you find that Curious Gorge is already engaged in battle with the creature...which appears to be a man outfitted in the same warrior's garb as your friend. You later learn that this man is, in fact, Curious Gorge's missing brother, Broken Mountain, and that he has succumbed to his inner beast and its insatiable bloodlust. In his attempt to free his brother from the beast's tightening grip, Curious Gorge, too, loses himself to the rage, and after toppling his brother, sets his frenzied gaze on you![@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
You have helped Curious Gorge regain control of his inner beast. Now speak with him once more at the Silver Bazaar to ensure that he is truly sound of mind.

Gagaruna of the Platinum Mirage has asked you to see to the protection of Professor Erik, an eminent scholar of Eorzean military history. Go and find this learned man at Ul'dah's chocobo stables, and guard his life with yours.

You have learned that Professor Erik means to study Eorzea's ancient battlefields using a revolutionary new method. His survey will begin with one such site closely related to the now centuries-dead nation of Sil'dih. Travel to Mythril Pit T[@1F]8, located to the south of Camp Drybone. There slay the indigenous runagate imps to ensure the Professor's well-being.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)
※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 35.

Professor Erik has asked that you aid him in measuring the aether concentrations of ancient battlefields. You are to travel to the area south of Cedarwood in lower La Noscea. There put down the beast known as Gluttonous Gertrude. Only after eliminating the dire threat she poses to the Professor's research can you safely use [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000552,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000552,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] he has provided.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 40.

The Professor is satisfied with the results of the measurements you took, and has requested that you aid him with two further tasks. You are to first collect the aetheriometer kept by Widargelt, after which he asks that you measure the aetherial concentration of the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars. Begin by heading south of Camp Drybone in southern Thanalan to Little Ala Mhigo, and seek out Widargelt.

Widargelt suspiciously informs you that his aether measurements are not yet complete. While waiting for his aetheriometer, see to the Professor's second task. Head to the North Shroud and find the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars, which lie to the north of Emerald Moss. Before safely taking your measurements, you will need to defeat yet another enemy of science and knowing─the Prince of Pestilence.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

You have defeated the Prince of Pestilence near the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars. Now find a suitable location for [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000553,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,2,11000553,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] and carry out the measurements requested by the Professor.
※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 45.

You are to first collect the aetheriometer kept by Widargelt, after which he asks that you measure the aetherial concentration of the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars. Begin by heading south of Camp Drybone in southern Thanalan to Little Ala Mhigo, and seek out Widargelt.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

Professor Erik is absolutely livid that you and Widargelt took measurements at the same location. After careful consideration of the results, however, he is on the verge of formulating yet another revolutionary new theory. To find the evidence he requires, take measurements in the area northwest of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan─a place where the aether is known to be in a state of great flux. Doing so will almost certainly require you to slay Apep, a basilisk known to inhabit the region.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that seven party members accompany you.
※ The next monk quest is now available from Widargelt.

Widargelt demands to know what you have told Professor Erik about him. He goes on to share with you knowledge about the monk's garb he is wearing. It seems the garb serves to channel and amplify the power of its wearer's chakras. Travel to the following ancient battlegrounds, and there search for the four artifacts he has hidden as part of your trial.[@CR]- Dzemael Darkhold, southwest of Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- The U'Ghamaro Mines, northeast of Iron Lake in upper La Noscea.[@CR]- Turning Leaf, south of Camp Crimson Bark in the West Shroud.[@CR]- A cliff overlooking the Sagolii desert, southeast of Ul'dah.
※ The next monk quest will be available from Erik upon reaching level 50.

The release of Professor Erik's theorem has been met with accolades in the scholarly community. All attempts to contact Widargelt and share the good news, however, have failed, nor has Widargelt responded to being hailed via linkpearl. The Professor concludes that he must have set out for Silvertear Falls─the only location where it is thought possible to open the seventh chakra. Hurry to the Falls and put an end to Widargelt's ambitions before disaster strikes.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

You arrive at Silvertear Falls only to find you are too late. Widargelt has already opened his seventh chakra, and with his newfound powers summarily annihilated a number of Garlean soldiers. The power flowing through his chakra is too great, however, and he has lost control over it. Defeat him to quell the rampant energy surging through him.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Widargelt explains that he sought power only to enable him to reclaim Ala Mhigo from the Empire's evil clutches. Already left physically devastated by the opening of his seventh chakra, Professor Erik adds insult to injury by lecturing Widargelt on the laws and ethics of power. Comfort Widargelt by speaking to him and telling him that everything is going to be just fine.

Speaking with Soileine of Stillglade Fane, you learn that thieves have been making off with items left at Lifemend Stump. Before the Conjurers' Guild could act, however, Seedseer Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna took matters into her own hands and ventured into the Twelveswood. It is believed that she is presently within a cave situated beneath a lake west of Camp Emerald Moss. Soileine bids you make your way there to ascertain the Seedseer's present condition.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Seedseer Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna tells you that the enchanted staff [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000551,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000551,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], a priceless Gridanian relic, was among the items stolen from Lifemend Stump. The thieves are believed to be a family of vilekin, a diremite straggler and her miteling brood, who are ensconced within the Mun[@1F]Tuy Cellars, north of Camp Emerald Moss. Your task is to put down the creatures and reclaim [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000551,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000551,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].[@CR][@CR]※ Up to three party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

The vilekin lie slain, and [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000551,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000551,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] is now safely in your hands. Hasten back to the lakeside cave and present the staff to Raya[@1F]O.
※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 35.

You return to the cave to find Raya[@1F]O in conversation with Oha[@1F]Sok. The Seedseer attempts to justify the need for nations to shore up their military might, but the elemental is unconvinced and takes her leave. Regaining her composure, Raya[@1F]O relays to you Twin Adder-sourced intelligence concerning a sheep that has turned feral southwest of Camp Glory. The creature, known to the locals as Downy Dunstan, is suspected to be acting under elemental influence. Raya[@1F]O requires that you subdue Downy Dunstan using white magic.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
You have subdued Downy Dunstan. Hasten back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.
Hearing of your mission's success, Raya[@1F]O contacts you by linkpearl and orders you to hasten back to the cave.
※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 40.

According to Raya[@1F]O, the elementals have begun to raise their voices in anger. She vows to do all in her power to quell their rage, and bids you assist her. You are told of Cactuar Jack, another creature suspected to have grown savage due to elemental influence. You must subdue the cactuar, who can be found east of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.
You have subdued Cactuar Jack. Hasten back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.
※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 45.

You are told of Cactuar Jack, another creature suspected to have grown savage due to elemental influence. You must subdue the cactuar, who can be found east of Camp Horizon in western Thanalan.[@CR][@CR]※ It is recommended that three party members accompany you.

Raya[@1F]O edifies you regarding the Fifth Astral Era, which ended when a great deluge came and cleansed the land of man's wickedness. Concerned that history may be about to repeat itself, the Seedseer is eager to do whatever she can to help set the world to rights. Reports have arrived that a bandit and his minions have taken to preying upon hapless travelers at the land bridge south of Camp Bearded Rock. Raya[@1F]O strongly suspects that they act under elemental influence, and bids you liberate the hapless souls.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

You have triumphed over the bandits and freed them from their enthrallment. Yet all is not well. Disheartened by mankind's readiness to hurt one another, Oha[@1F]Sak give you an ominous warning before taking her leave. Hasten back to the cave and tell Raya[@1F]O all that has transpired.
※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 45.

Raya[@1F]O believes that Oha[@1F]Sok has been observing the children of the Sixth Astral Era, suggesting that she has yet to give up on mankind. Nevertheless, the presence of wrath incarnate alone is enough to impel the elementals to sustain their keening indefinitely, which will inevitably lead to catastrophe. In order to restore the enraged elementals to calm, Raya[@1F]O bids you acquire the garb of succor, the legendary artifacts worn by the white mages of old. Raya[@1F]O has marked the whereabouts of four pieces on your map.[@CR]- Dzemael Darkhold, southwest of Camp Dragonhead in the Coerthas central highlands.[@CR]- Zahar'ak, east of Camp Broken Water in southern Thanalan.[@CR]- Turning Leaf, south of Camp Crimson Bark in the West Shroud.[@CR]- Tiger Helm Island, southeast of Camp Bloodshore in eastern La Noscea.
Four pieces of the garb of succor are now in your possession. Make your way back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.
※ The next white mage quest will be available from Raya[@1F]O[@1F]Senna upon reaching level 50.

Oha[@1F]Sok's return to the Twelveswood has prompted the elementals to intensify their keening; it is only a matter of time before catastrophe is unleashed upon Eorzea. Even though the fifth and final artifact eludes you still, you must act now lest the unthinkable come to pass. Raya[@1F]O senses the keening most strongly southwest of Camp Bentbranch, and bids you quell the elementals there.[@CR][@CR]※ Up to seven party members may accompany you. (Recommended)

Just when all seems lost, Oha[@1F]Sok arrives to save you from her kindred's wrath. In a touching turn of events, the elemental of nihility then offers to remain by your side, transforming into the final artifact of succor. Hasten back to the cave where Raya[@1F]O awaits.
